dct_title_s: t'Neemen van de Suyker Prysen in de Bay de Tode los Santos
dct_description_sm: Bird's eye view of Baía de Todos os Santos.
Depicts the Dutch fleet under Piet Heyn capturing the fort at the entrance to the the Baia de Todos os Santos.
Shows buildings, forts, ships, figures, vegetation.
From Commelin's Histoire de la vie & actes memorrables de Frederic Henry Prince de Nassau Prince d'Orange, 1656.
This copy has "Fol. 23" in bottom right corner; pencil inscription in lower left: 561.
